description: This file implements a process management module for Playwright, handling inter-process communication, process lifecycle, and request-response messaging.

classes.name: ProcessRunner
classes.description: Handles process lifecycle, event dispatching, and messaging with parent process.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the parent process.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to the parent process and awaits response.

methods.name: sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message to the parent process without expecting a reply.
